description: List bookings: who is registered for, attended, no-showed or late-cancelled which event, and with which customer membership. Filter by customer, event, venue, offering type, status or event start window. Use expand=customer,event for names. TeamUp: GET /attendances.

event_starts_at_gte.description: Only attendances for events starting at or after (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

event_starts_at_lte.description: Only attendances for events starting at or before (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand into full objects (dot-nested, max depth 4), e.g. customer,event.instructors.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (dot notation for nested), e.g. id,name,starts_at.

status.description: Attendance status; plans_to_attend = registered or waitlisted.

name: goteamup_list_attendances
title: List attendances (bookings)
